description: This file defines a Python class for an MCP (Model Context Protocol) client, which enables integration of external tools with language models through various server connection types (stdio, SSE, HTTP). It includes methods for discovering, converting schemas, and calling tools asynchronously, along with filtering capabilities, making it a core part of tool integration in the project.

classes.name: MCPClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, supporting tool discovery, schema conversion, and tool invocation over different connection types.

methods.name: ToolsSchema register_tools(self, llm: LLMService | LLMSwitcher)
methods.description: Discovers tools from the MCP server and registers them with an LLM service.

methods.name: ToolsSchema get_tools_schema(self)
methods.description: Fetches the schema of available MCP tools without registration.

methods.name: None register_tools_schema( self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema, llm: LLMService | LLMSwitcher )
methods.description: Registers a provided tools schema with an LLM service.

methods.name: FunctionSchema _convert_mcp_schema_to_pipecat( self, tool_name: str, tool_schema: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Converts an MCP tool schema to the Pipecat FunctionSchema format.

methods.name: ToolsSchema _sse_list_tools(self)
methods.description: Lists MCP tools over an SSE connection.

methods.name: None _sse_tool_wrapper(self, params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Wraps an MCP SSE tool call to fit Pipecat's interface.

methods.name: ToolsSchema _stdio_list_tools(self)
methods.description: Lists MCP tools over a stdio connection.

methods.name: None _stdio_tool_wrapper(self, params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Wraps an MCP stdio tool call to fit Pipecat's interface.

methods.name: ToolsSchema _streamable_http_list_tools(self)
methods.description: Lists MCP tools over a streamable HTTP connection.

methods.name: None _streamable_http_tool_wrapper(self, params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Wraps an MCP streamable HTTP tool call to fit Pipecat's interface.

methods.name: _call_tool(self, session, function_name, arguments, result_callback)
methods.description: Handles execution of an MCP tool and processes results, including callback invocation.

methods.name: _list_tools_helper(self, session)
methods.description: Helper method to list and process available tools from a session.
